title: Categorical Realizations of Hodge Atoms: Singular Spectra, Irregular Stokes, and Hecke Geometry
content: We investigate categorical and Hodge-theoretic realizations of singular spectral geometry through conifold degenerations, irregular Stokes structures, and Hecke modifications. For the determinantal conifold, matrix factorizations and twisted de Rham theory yield an explicit critical-value spectral operator and its meromorphic connection. A cubic Gauss–Manin system realizes Morse vanishing cycles as irregular exponential grades with nontrivial Stokes incidence. Framed minuscule \( GL_2 \) modifications identify exceptional-curve Hodge classes with the geometric data determining the normalized mixed-Hodge-module forward-Ext line. These structures admit a local comparison through a stabilized \( A_2 \) deformation: its ramified spectral cover \( T^2=\frac49s^3 \) governs the collision of critical values, the failure of generic spectral projectors to extend, and the corresponding Fourier–Laplace exponential data. At generic Morse points, boundary duality supplies Hodge-line comparisons compatible with framed Hecke geometry. The resulting spectral–Stokes–Hecke correspondence provides a concrete local model for extension-sensitive categorical realizations and bivariant Hodge-atom operations.
